name: Stickman School Run
userInputText: Leap and overcome obstacles to let the boy reach the position of his lover in Stickman School Run. Dash through tricky terrain and clear all the levels!Stickman School Run is a school-themed game with creative running and jumping gameplay. You will control a stickman, or rather, a sketchy humanoid drawing, trying to get to his girlfriend. However, don't let the simplicity of the design fool you. In the world of Stickman School Run, each platform and each obstacle is a new challenge, requiring flexibility and quick reactions on your part. You can jump, roll, or even launch the ruler over obstacles to reach your goal.With 100 challenging levels, the game never makes you feel bored. The meticulous and creative design of each level forces you to focus and devise the right strategy to pass. The mix of magic and challenge makes this game especially engaging and requires absolute concentration on the part of the player. An interesting thing is that when you replay a level many times, the maps can change. Therefore, you not only explore the available levels but actually do much more.How to ControlEach type of obstacle will have a different way to be overcome. You will only need the arrow keys to fully experience this game. Specifically:Press the up arrow key to make the character jump up. You can use this command to ascend to a higher platform or leap over stacks of books.Hold down the up arrow key to zoom in on the ruler, pushing back boxes that get in the way.Use the right arrow key to curl the character, avoiding collisions with the combo.Use the down arrow key to perform a higher jump.Running and jumping games with obstaclesOVOGeometry WorldBlue Mushroom Cat Run
